name: Plaid
one_liner: Financial data API for connecting end-user bank accounts to apps via Plaid Link.
auth_notes: Server requests carry client_id and secret (body or PLAID-CLIENT-ID / PLAID-SECRET headers). End-user bank links return a public token that is exchanged server-side for an access token.
access_notes: Create a developer account, then find API keys in the Dashboard. Production needs a completed application and company profile. Cost is not stated on the pages read; the Trial plan page returned 403.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve sandbox keys and a documented API, but end users must complete Plaid Link. Production needs a completed application profile before some institutions work. Larger deployments route through sales.

identity.quote: In this guide, we'll demonstrate how to add Auth to your app so that you can connect to your users' bank accounts

auth.quote: On your application server, exchange the public token for an access token and an Item ID by calling /item/public_token/exchange.

access.quote: If you don't already have one, you'll need to create a Plaid developer account.

sandbox.quote: Sandbox Studio is a no-code way to explore Plaid products from the Dashboard, using Sandbox test data.

api_surface.quote: The Plaid OpenAPI file is available on GitHub.
Simulate a Plaid webhook event in the sandbox environment

mcp.quote: The Plaid AI coding toolkit ships with a local MCP server that runs as a subprocess of your MCP client

buildability.quote: Your application profile and company profile must be completed before connecting to certain institutions in Production.
